corpus_provenance: Hand-authored synthetic diagnostic screen, not real agent tasks. Second variants reverse options and add neutral framing. Source groups are disjoint across splits. No Laya outputs were used to create labels.
threshold_policy: Highest development coverage at >=95% observed accepted accuracy; ties stricter. No eligible threshold means no proposed automatic gate.

robustness_diagnostics.provenance: Additional negation/paraphrase diagnostics authored after the initial synthetic screen. Not part of the frozen 180-case held-out study; no threshold tuning or deployment claim.
